privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.description: What Ryzon Automation collects when you request a demo or contact us, why, and how to ask us to delete it.
privacy.intro: This page explains what information Ryzon Automation (“we”, “us”) collects through this website, what we do with it, and the choices you have.

body: We only collect what you type into our forms:

list: Demo request: your name, email, business name, phone number, industry, the website style you picked, your current website (optional), and any notes you add (optional).
Contact form: your name, email, and your message.
With each form we also record which form you used, the page it came from, and the time it was sent.
To design your free demo and send it to you.
To follow up about the demo or a plan you asked about.

body: We don’t sell your information, and we don’t share it with anyone for their own marketing.
When you send a form, it goes through an automation service (n8n) that emails it to our team (Gmail). Those services process the information only to deliver it to us.
If we turn on website analytics, it measures things like page visits and button clicks to help us improve the site. [CONFIRM: analytics provider, once chosen]
You can ask us to see, correct, or delete the information you sent us. Email us at the address below and we’ll take care of it.
Your browser stores the website style you pick so the page remembers it next time. That stays on your device, and clearing your browser data removes it.
[CONFIRM: how long demo and contact submissions are kept]
If we change this policy, we’ll update this page and the date at the top.

terms.title: Terms of service
terms.description: The terms for Ryzon Automation’s website plans: the free demo, pricing, cancellation, site ownership, and edits.
terms.intro: These terms cover Ryzon Automation’s website design plans. By requesting a demo or starting a plan, you agree to them.

list: The demo is free, with no obligation to buy anything.
We design a preview of your site, which can be ready as soon as the next day.
Once your demo is sent, changes start when you pick a plan. If you’d like to see a completely different design before you decide, just ask.

body: What each plan includes is listed on the pricing section of our home page. [CONFIRM: billing method and renewal terms]

list: Paying yearly gets you 2 months free on every plan.
For a limited time, every plan is $0 upfront.

body: You can cancel anytime. If you cancel before your first year is up, the design files are not included.
We own and manage the site for the first year. After that, if you decide to leave, we export your site files and deliver them to you to manage.

list: Complete Package: changes and additions are free for the life of your site.
Starter and Growth: edits are handled per project. Simple tasks may be free depending on how long you’ve been with us. Everything else is quoted at $20/hour before work starts.

body: You’re responsible for the text, photos, and logos you give us, and for having the right to use them. We use them only to build and run your site.
These terms are governed by the laws of the State of Michigan. [CONFIRM]
If we change these terms, we’ll update this page and the date at the top.
